layers.name: Domain Model
layers.description: Pure domain entities, value objects, aggregates and repository interfaces for each bounded context (cargo, handling, voyage, location, pathfinder), plus the handling glossary.

layers.name: Application Services
layers.description: Use-case orchestration: booking, routing, tracking, handling registration, admin map and sample data.

layers.name: Persistence Infrastructure
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations and schema migrations.

layers.name: Interfaces & Presentation
layers.description: Views, forms, URL routes, REST/pathfinder APIs, tracking adapters and HTML templates.

layers.name: Management & Data Migration
layers.description: Django management commands and data snapshot export/load tooling.

layers.name: Project Configuration & Composition
layers.description: Django settings, root URLconf, ASGI/WSGI entry points, app configs, package markers and composition roots wiring contexts.

tour.title: Project Entry Points & Configuration
tour.description: Start at settings.py and urls.py: they list the installed bounded-context apps (cargo, handling, voyage, location, pathfinder, booking) and route the tracking page, handling-report REST endpoint, admin map and pathfinder API.

tour.title: The Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The heart of the domain: Cargo is an aggregate root with a tracking ID, route specification, itinerary and delivery. These are immutable value objects in classic DDD style.

tour.title: Delivery: Deriving Cargo Status
tour.description: Delivery derives transport status, routing status and misdirection from the itinerary and handling history, using expected handling activities.

tour.title: Handling Events
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to cargo (load, unload, receive, claim...). Registration attempts queue reports for asynchronous processing; repository interfaces and exceptions live in the domain.

tour.title: Voyages and Locations
tour.description: Voyage aggregates hold a schedule of carrier movements, and Location entities are identified by UN/LOCODE value objects.

tour.title: Repository Ports
tour.description: Domain-defined repository interfaces (Protocols) decouple business logic from persistence.

tour.title: Persistence with Django ORM
tour.description: Infrastructure adapters implement the repositories, mapping ORM records to domain objects. The top-level models.py files re-export them so Django discovers them.
tour.languageLesson: Re-exporting ORM models from models.py is needed because Django only auto-discovers models in each app's models module, while this project keeps them in infrastructure/.

tour.title: Application Services: Booking
tour.description: Use cases orchestrate domain objects: registering a cargo, changing its route specification and finding candidate routes through the pathfinder.

tour.title: Pathfinder Context
tour.description: A separate bounded context offering shortest-path routing, exposed through a JSON API with value objects for transit edges and paths.

tour.title: Handling Registration Pipeline
tour.description: A REST report is accepted and queued, then a management command processes the queue asynchronously, resolving cargo, location and voyage.

tour.title: Composition Roots
tour.description: Composition modules wire concrete repositories into application services, keeping dependency injection explicit.

tour.title: Tracking UI
tour.description: Views, forms and presentation helpers turn domain state into readable status text, ETA, history and map frames, rendered via HTMX templates.

tour.title: Booking Wizard & Admin Live Map
tour.description: The multi-step booking wizard and the admin live map, which polls markers via HTMX and renders them with Leaflet.

tour.title: Seed Data & Data Migration
tour.description: Management commands seed sample data and export or load CSV snapshots driven by YAML mappings.
